card.name: Linking words in stepwise dose schedules
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as as, followed, first, of, at, until in dosing instructions. They sit right where the next step of a regimen or sequence is about to be named.

modes.label: Followed by next step
modes.description: The word 'followed' or 'then' links one dose to the next dose or drug in a sequence.
modes.example: 3 40 mg initially followed by repeat intravenous injection every 4 to 6 hours while shock persists Oaks 4 40 mg initially<< followed>> by repeat intravenous injection every 2

modes.label: Introducing a dose or condition
modes.description: A short word such as as, at, of, or until comes just before a dose amount or condition.

modes.label: Order of drugs
modes.description: A word or comma after the first-given drug, before the next drug in the order.
modes.example: on the same day of dosing. IMJUDO in Combination with Durvalumab and Platinum-based Chemotherapy • Infuse IMJUDO first<<,>> followed by durvalumab and then

card.writes: Suppresses words meaning 'remainder' or 'the rest', so it steers away from vague wording about what is left.
card.plain: It marks the small linking words in a dosing schedule where the next step of the plan comes next.
